recordings.previousText: The king is tucked away. Castling moved king and rook in a single turn, with the rook settling next to the king. Safety first, then the real work.
recordings.text: King and rook moved in a single turn, with the rook settling next to the king. Castling isn't safety by itself: check the king's new home, then get to work.
recordings.reason: The review checks only that castling happened, not that the king ended up safer; castling into an attack made 'shelter' and 'safety first' false.
